links.outcome: Automatic FLART plan quality versus manual FLART and conventional plans, including blinded clinician review
links.effect: 87.9% of automatic plans clinically acceptable without modification; 68.7% rated comparable (38.4%) or superior (30.3%) to manual FLART plans; high-function lung mean dose reduced 15.1% versus manual ConvRT.
links.quote: Blinded reviews indicated that 87.9% of automatic FLART plans were clinically acceptable without modification, and 68.7% were rated as comparable (38.4%) or superior (30.3%) to manual FLART plans.

unlisted_practices: Comparing AI-generated radiotherapy plans with manual plans using dosimetric metrics and normal tissue complication probability estimates
Measuring planning time savings from AI auto-planning

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, clinical acceptability, and dosimetric outcomes of an AI-driven radiotherapy treatment planning system integrated into clinical software via retrospective case analysis and clinician blinded review, without testing a deployment safeguard/practice.
